en: Did you come all this way just to see me?
If so, I would be so happy.
But I'm sure that isn't the case, is it?
You're so wonderful, after all. Someone like me...
No, but... the fact that you speak to me
like this is my greatest joy.
Oh, have you come to watch again?
At this rate, I never know when
is
note: 'when NAME is / watching' - sa-n particle dropped; name is the subject

en: watching me, so I can't keep my mind on
my thread. Ohohohoho.
Weaving is rather hard work, you know.
If I were only making silk, it would be easy,
but... ah, well.
Still, with someone like you watching over me,
it feels like it's all worthwhile.
See, over there, I spin wool into thread.
Then I weave that thread into cloth,
you see.
We use the cloth ourselves, of course,
but we sell it to other towns too.
Look, I've finished another piece.
Ah, I wish I could make a present for you

en: out of cloth like this, and give it to
you...
But it might be a nuisance for you, mightn't it?
I know! If you would care to accept anything
from me, then come to my house sometime,
won't you? Please do. I'm counting on it.
Ah, thinking back, why on earth did I give
a shepherd like that a second thought,
when our work simply happened to be near?
Oh, did I just say something?
Oh, how polite of you. You're so young and lovely that
note: ends 'that' to run into M0#1942 "I didn't know what to do." (slice 024)

Ah, I think I'm going to faint.
I'm so timid, and yet
you frighten me like that.
Ah, I'm unsteady again...
Whoa, careful.
Oh.
Oh my, aren't you being rather sudden...

so...

en: I would do anything for you...
Oh, hello.
What a lovely person you are. Where have you come from?
Actually, I've been around here a long time.
Though until now I lived a little way
off from here.
Oh, is that so?
If you stay indoors all the time,
note: generic 'you'; also used by msg 99383 with #2094

en: you lose touch even with what's around you.
Even someone who's been here that long
finds this house unusual, I wonder.
I'm not making anything right now.
Every year around this time, the whole room
fills up with a sweet smell.
Would you like to taste some freshly made butter?
A man who takes an interest in winter prep like this
is rare, isn't he?
I'm making jam right now.
It's surprisingly easy to make,
and this way it keeps for a long time.
Oh, you've been here before, haven't you?
I'm making jam right now, you know.
Even half-made jam is delicious,
but resisting a taste is so hard.
Today I'm making grape jam.
Making it into wine is nice too, but
I like eating them as jam as well.
